o: An alternating subarray starts with a rise of exactly +1 and then oscillates ±1: differences must be +1, -1, +1, -1, ... In [2,3,4,3,4] the run 3,4,3,4 has differences +1,-1,+1,-1 and length 4, the maximum. In [4,5,6] no run longer than 2 exists (4,5,6 has differences +1,+1), so the answer is 2. With n <= 100 even an O(n^2) enumeration of all start points is fine, but an O(n) scan tracking the current valid run length is cleaner.
k: A run breaks when the required difference (+1 at even steps, -1 at odd steps) fails.
When a run breaks, the next candidate run may restart at the previous element (it can serve as the start of a new +1 rise).
Answer is at least 2 whenever any adjacent pair differs by exactly 1; otherwise -1.

a.i: For each starting index i where nums[i+1] = nums[i] + 1, extend j as long as the oscillation holds, recording the best length. This directly mirrors the definition and is trivially correct.
s: For each i from 0 to n-2, require nums[i+1] - nums[i] == 1 to start a run.
Extend j from i+1 while the expected alternating differences hold.
Update the answer with j - i + 1; return the max or -1.
a.t: O(n^2) worst case — each start may extend to the end, fine for n <= 100.
a.sp: O(1) — only indices and the answer.

a.i: Walk once, maintaining cur = length of the alternating run ending at index i, and exp = the difference the next step must have. If nums[i+1] - nums[i] equals exp, extend; otherwise the run resets — but if the new difference is +1, a fresh run of length 2 starts at i, else length 0. This gives O(n) total.
s: For each i, if nums[i+1] - nums[i] == exp: cur = (cur == 0 ? 2 : cur + 1); exp = -exp.
Track ans = max(ans, cur); return ans.
a.t: O(n) — single pass with constant work per step.

w: Use the linear scan if asked for optimal; the brute-force version is perfectly acceptable at n <= 100 and easier to get right. Test edge cases: strictly increasing arrays (answer 2), constant arrays (-1), and runs that restart mid-array like [1,2,1,2,3,4]. Pitfall: forgetting that a broken run can immediately restart with length 2 when the offending difference is +1. Follow-up: longest alternating subarray with arbitrary amplitude a, or k-periodic differences.
